$comment: Model id -> the route that ran the model (the route enum of TestMyAgent). Read by apps/web2, apps/api and the local-result validator, through packages/contracts/model-catalog.js. The web3 client apps/web does not read this file.
The id prefix before the first '/' decides. It mirrors services/runner/src/model-route.ts: 'opencode-go/' runs on opencode go;
every other TestMyAgent run goes to OpenRouter (an OpenRouter id starts with its author slug: 'anthropic/', 'z-ai/', 'qwen/').
The other prefixes name executors whose results come in as self-declared local results (they never run on the TMA runner).
